findings.message: PROCESS, not a defect: the rev-12 verify node returned two majors — my previous edit to the free-text refusal never applied (a silent no-op replace: the lesson I had just written into the wiki), and the URL rule required a non-empty username so `redis://:hunter2@cache:6379` rendered its password — plus two minors (raw-string same-path exemption, stale setCapture contract). All fixed in this revision, together with the REAL cause of the flaky real-Docker suites (vitest runs test FILES in parallel and both Docker suites use the same fixture containers). Re-sealing.
